snippet.title: Kettlebell: Inferno Hotel - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Kettlebell: Inferno Hotel is a fast-paced 2D platformer inspired by the 16-bit classics of the ’90s — packed with humor, destruction, and pure hellish energy!

The main character, Mr. K, is an ordinary office clerk and an all-around nice guy. But fate takes a darkly comic turn: a ridiculous accident sends him not to heaven, but straight to the depths of hell.
